Unfortunately, I have not received any response or the promised RMA shipping label to this day.   Since the miner has now been defective for almost a month (since September 15) and the process has stalled, I kindly but firmly ask you to send me the RMA shipping label for order  Shop····  within the next 2–3 business days.  Please briefly confirm the current status and let me know when I can expect the label.  Thank you for your support and best regards, Michael R. We understand you’re getting a voltage protection error even though you’ve confirmed the power supply is providing 12.19 V, and that you’ve already completed a full factory reset without resolving the issue. Thanks again for your patience, Michael. We’re sorry again for the wait.

Hi Michael,

First, I'm sorry. We told you on September 24 that we would take this over and send you the prepaid return label, and then it never came. You should not have had to chase us for it. We have had changes on the support team recently, and your case slipped through. That is on us.

I have your order in front of me, Shop····, the NerdOctaxe 12 TH/s delivered on July 23, with the voltage protection error you reported on September 15 after a full factory reset at 12.19 V.

To get the RMA moving and the prepaid return label issued, please fill in our RMA form here:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSccBFl4kT-KBce4Dz2g6tJW-DKO6AiBUfsnDRKveTaPpEcmDA/viewform

Put your order number Shop···· in it, plus a short description of the fault (voltage protection error, 12.19 V at the PSU, factory reset done). That is all we need.

Once the form is in, the team sends you the return label and the next steps for shipping the unit back. I have flagged your case so it is picked up as soon as the office opens tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and the reply comes to this email address.

Thanks for your patience with this, Michael, and sorry again for the silence.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
